findings.summary: `rename` fetches the document via `self.repo.get(doc_id)` without calling `self._owned(user_id, doc_id)`, so any authenticated user can rename another user's document (authorization bypass/IDOR) and can probe which ids exist.

judge.reason: Identifies rename using repo.get instead of _owned, allowing cross-user rename and id probing.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: The ownership check should occur before title validation so non-owners always get NotFound rather than an input-dependent ValueError.

judge.reason: Concerns ordering of validation vs ownership check, not the missing ownership check itself; speculative minor point and doesn't describe the core defect.

findings.label: false_alarm
